references.text: Confirms that the Lord is God, and there is no other besides him.
The Lord is God in heaven above and on earth below; there is no other.
The Lord declares that before him no god was formed, and after him none will come. He alone is the Lord.
The Lord is the first and the last, and apart from him there is no God.
There is no God besides the Lord, no other god.
The Lord shall be king over all the earth. On that day the Lord will be one and his name one.
Jesus quotes the Shema as the first and greatest commandment, confirming that the Lord our God is one Lord.
The scribe confirms Jesus' quote and says that God is one, and there is no other besides him.
Paul affirms that there is only one God, the Father, and one Lord, Jesus Christ.
God is one, a confirmation of monotheism from the Shema.
One Lord, one faith, one baptism, one God and Father of all.
There is one God and one mediator between God and mankind.
You believe that God is one; you do well. Even the demons believe—and shudder.
